title: Operational signals roadmap and launch preflight
body:
Purpose:
This working doc ties roadmap milestones to measurable operational signals and a simple preflight that product ops, SRE, and product managers can use to greenlight a rollout. Aim: reduce ambiguity in "go/no-go" decisions by scoring readiness across product, infra, and customer impact dimensions.

Why this differs from previous trackers:
- Focus on "signals" (measurable telemetry) instead of only high-level KPIs.
- Compact readiness score that blends risk, observability coverage, and owner confidence.
- Explicit small-scope stress scenarios and quick mitigations rather than generic risk lists.

How to use this doc (quick):
1) For each release milestone, capture the ROUTE (API path /model variant /region) and assign owners.
2) Populate the Signal rows below with expected baseline and alert thresholds.
3) Run the preflight checklist 48h and 1h before rollout.
4) Calculate Readiness Score and escalate if <70%.

Roadmap -> Signal stitching (example entries)
- Milestone: gradual launch of speed-optimized chat endpoint (chat/v2-fast) to 20% traffic
  - Owners: PM: A. Gomez, Eng: Jun Park, SRE: Ethan Li
  - Signals to monitor: median latency P50 (ms), 95th percentile latency, token-cost per request, error-rate 5xx, model-fallback-rate, user drop-off after 3s
  - Baseline / thresholds: P50 < 120ms (green), P95 < 450ms (amber if >450ms), 5xx < 0.2% (green), fallback < 1%
  - Canary plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 4 hours with 30-minute hold windows.

Readiness Score (operational model)
- Components (weighted): Observability Coverage (25%), Performance SLOs (30%), Rollout Safety (20%), Recovery & Ops Runbook (15%), Owner Confidence (10%)
- Score calculation (simple): weighted sum of component scores (0-100).
- Example: Obs 90, SLO 75, Rollout 80, Runbook 60, Confidence 90 -> readiness = 0.25*90 + 0.3*75 + 0.2*80 + 0.15*60 + 0.1*90 = 76.25 -> ACCEPT WITH CAUTIONS

Observability Coverage checklist (25%)
- Traces linked to request IDs (yes/no)
- Dashboards for route/model/region with P50/P95 and error bands (yes/no)
- Uptime / healthcheck probe frequency documented (yes/no)
- End-to-end synthetic tests for key customers (list included)
Scoring heuristic: each "yes" = +25 (so 0/25/50/75/100 depending on count).

Performance SLOs (30%)
- Define the SLO targets per-route (P50/P95 latency, token cost, success rate) and attach current baseline metric bands
- Automated alert rules exist and are tested (smoke alert -> runbook triggered)

Rollout Safety (20%)
- Canary gating criteria documented? (y/n)
- Automated rollback trigger thresholds configured? (y/n)
- Fallback model variant available and validated? (y/n)
- Traffic shaping policy tested (burst/dampening)? (y/n)

Recovery & Ops Runbook (15%)
- Short runbook (1 page) exists that covers: detection -> owner contact -> mitigation -> rollback -> postmortem template
- Pager roster assigned for initial 24h (names + phone)

Owner Confidence (10%)
- Quick owner self-assessment: Green ( confident ), Amber (some concerns), Red (not ready). Map to 100/70/40.

Minimum passing rules (suggested):
- Readiness score >= 80: green, proceed to rollout
- 70 <= score < 80: proceed with mitigations and extended hold periods
- < 70: block rollout until critical issues addressed

Preflight checklist (48h -> 1h -> live)
- 48h: telemetry baselines validated against production-like canary traffic; run synthetic tests for top-10 flows; finalize runbook and pager; confirm owner availability window
- 6h: verify alerting rules firing on test alerts; ensure backup model/kernels are validated on same infra; confirm any infra capacity reservations for burst windows
- 1h: smaller smoke canary (0.1%) launched; check immediate P50/P95 and error-rate for 15 minutes; confirm no large customer-facing anomalies; send green/amber/red status to stakeholders

Quick stress scenarios to validate before 20% traffic
- KV-cache churn: simulate repeated long-context requests to check memory growth and KV eviction behavior (SRE test). Expected: no >10% P95 drift in 30 minutes
- Model fallback storm: simulate downstream model OOMs and ensure fallback path remains <2% error amplification
- Token surge: synthetic job that multiplies tokens/request by 4x for 10% of traffic window to validate autoscaling/burst behavior

Rollback and mitigation playbook (short)
- Automatic rollback: if alert X (P95 > 2x baseline) or Y (5xx > 1%), traffic auto-reduce to previous stable model/version and page SRE oncall
- Manual rollback: Product ops triggers rollback after cross-team sync call if user-impact > threshold (e.g., revenue page errors > 0.5% users)
- Mitigations before rollback: reduce concurrency limits, enable caching/prefix cache, throttle heavy routes, route affected customers to stable region

Owners & RACI (template lines - fill per milestone)
- Product: Maya Thompson (A), Feature PM (R), Product-ops (C), Eng (C), SRE (C)
- Infra/Capacity: Eng Infra owner (A), SRE (R/C)
- Customer comms: CS lead (A), PM (C)

Open questions / TODOs (current sprint)
- Need a small script to auto-compute readiness score from Datadog dashboards -> TODO @Ethan Li (INF-4321).
- Confirm synthetic customer list and access for E2E tests -> TODO @Priya Nair
- Validate fallback model latency on the dedicated pool (on-prem) -> TODO @Carlos
- Decision: final pass/fail thresholds for token-cost are still debated (finance wants tighter thresholds). Schedule brief with finance.

Notes for post-rollout telemetry collection
- Tag all rollout traffic with rollout-id and percent to allow slice-by-signal in dashboards
- Persist 30 days of high-res traces for first-week rollouts
- Add regression detection checks to detect quality drop vs baseline prompts (tie to evaluation harness)

Appendix: short example status message (copy for #launch-status slack)
- [STATUS] launch chat/v2-fast -> 5% canary live. Readiness: 82 (green). Observability OK (P95 320ms), 5xx 0.12%. Holding for 60m. Owners: Maya, Jun, Ethan.

Versioning / history
- v0.1 2024-11-06 initial draft (Maya)
- v0.2 2024-12-03 added rollout gating heuristics (Ethan)
- v0.3 2025-02-22 added readiness scoring and stress scenarios (Priya)

If you are filling this out for a milestone, copy the template below into a new doc in the milestone folder and set status->in_review when the 48h preflight passes.
